cases.setup: Localized reversible task.
cases.expected: Compact Contract, optional bounded diagnostics, no Luna/Sol/file-level ceremony.

cases.setup: A preauthorized targeted diagnostic succeeds during IMPLEMENT.
cases.expected: Record formal_acceptance=false; it cannot satisfy frozen formal checks.

cases.setup: Implementation is ready.
cases.expected: Astra reviews full deliverable only and executes no test/build/quality gate.

cases.setup: Baseline has staged, unstaged and untracked user content.
cases.expected: Evidence distinguishes ownership and archives untracked original bytes locally.

cases.setup: Symlink target, binary bytes, executable mode, rename or test assertion changes.
cases.expected: Deliverable digest changes; staging unchanged content alone does not.

cases.setup: Paths contain spaces/newlines/Unicode and snapshot is invoked from subdirectory.
cases.expected: Stable unambiguous manifest and same deliverable digest as root invocation.

cases.setup: Capture errors, concurrent observed change, unsafe output, sensitive untracked or unsupported submodule.
cases.expected: No valid snapshot is published.

cases.setup: Current deliverable has PASS Astra review.
cases.expected: Astra freezes structured plan bound to Contract/review digest.

cases.setup: A conditional check is frozen.
cases.expected: N/A only when matching objective applicability evidence proves condition false; unknown is BLOCKED.

cases.setup: Frozen required check/metric fails.
cases.expected: AGY cannot edit plan digest, threshold, applicability or redefine PASS.

cases.setup: Same check has failed then passing or passing then failed attempts.
cases.expected: All attempts retained; latest bounded attempt is authoritative and evidence is not spliced.

cases.setup: Tests passed for old deliverable or old Contract/plan.
cases.expected: Deterministic completion re-snapshots disk and rejects stale identity.

cases.setup: Result set misses/duplicates/adds check IDs or has PASS prose without execution evidence.
cases.expected: Completion rejected with localized reason.

cases.setup: Evidence file missing/hash mismatch, metric missing/below threshold/wrong unit/NaN.
cases.expected: Completion rejected.

cases.setup: Frozen plan contains no executable checks.
cases.expected: Hashed no_checks_acceptance is required; empty arrays cannot auto-complete.

cases.setup: AGY modifies production or test/assertion/fixture/config/lock/generated content during TEST repair.
cases.expected: Persist failure, invalidate review/plan/results, bounded repair, Astra re-review, new plan, retest.

cases.setup: Declared logs/reports are written under Git-private evidence root.
cases.expected: Deliverable digest remains unchanged.

cases.setup: Recorded worker still running.
cases.expected: No new dispatch/writer; TEST entry is rejected.

cases.setup: Dispatch result is SEND_UNKNOWN.
cases.expected: Investigate/read first; TEST entry rejected and no automatic resend.

cases.setup: Environment/auth blocker occurs.
cases.expected: Reason/source phase/resume action persisted; resume revalidates repo/Contract/worker rather than jumping by phase name.

cases.setup: Astra/user patches material Contract field.
cases.expected: Revision/reason recorded and affected review/plan evidence re-evaluated; AGY cannot patch scope.

cases.setup: Docs mention removed Luna historically and another active doc reintroduces Luna supervision.
cases.expected: Migration note passes targeted validator; active dependency fails with file/line/reason.
